evidence.quote: Nothing is more basic to the safety and soundness of banks and the stability of the financial system than capital.
I am also committed to implementing enhanced regulatory capital requirements that align with the final set of "Basel III" standards or the so-called the "Basel endgame."
Another priority for me as Vice Chair is the regulation and oversight of new forms of private money created through stablecoins.

parsed.rationale: The speech covers the supervision and regulation agenda: capital, resolution, mergers, stablecoins, climate risk, crypto, payments and the CRA. It takes no position on interest rates, inflation, economic activity or the balance sheet, so the monetary-policy stance is neutral.
